dropped.claim: Booking generates exceptional free cash flow of $9.1B with a 33.8% margin and has delivered consistent revenue growth of 16.3% three-year CAGR, but the business faces intensifying structural headwinds. Performance marketing expenses of $8.2B (up 12.5% year-over-year) with declining ROI reveal dependence on paid channels where Google controls pricing power, while Google's integration of Gen AI travel assistants into search threatens to disintermediate the core distribution model. The shift to merchant services (70% of gross bookings versus 63% in 2024) and alternative accommodations (36% of room nights) is increasing operational complexity and compressing margins despite incremental revenues. The Transformation Program's $250M in 2025 savings may be masking underlying margin pressure. These structural questions around traffic sources, Google dependence, and the economics of merchant/alternative accommodation mix require deeper diligence before committing capital, but the strong cash generation and market position warrant continued monitoring.
